title: Manoj v. State of Madhya Pradesh

content.caseIdentity: Manoj v. State of Madhya Pradesh, (2023) 2 SCC 353
content.holding: Mandated strict procedural guidelines for pre-sentence hearings: the trial court must obtain a psychiatric evaluation, jail conduct report, and probation officer report before imposing capital punishment to test whether the possibility of reformation is completely foreclosed.
content.relevance: Mandatory procedural safeguard governing Section 258(2) BNSS sentencing for offences under Section 103 BNS.
